text:
anika: Heads-up — we're seeing intermittent inter-node latency spikes (p95 ~25ms -> 120ms) between GPU nodes in us-east-1 during the 11:30-12:00 batching ramp. Affects gpu-pool-6, observed across jobs that hit continuous small-token batching. Autoscaler and queueing blow up when this happens.

samir: Any packet loss or link flaps? MTU mismatches? Which TORs are in the path?

anika: Packet loss is low (<0.1%) on interface counters, but latency jumps align with batching ramps. TORs: tor-us-east-3a-12 and tor-us-east-3a-13. Switch counters show increased output-queue drops on .12 when the ramp starts. Drivers were updated last week (Mellanox/mlnx_en 5.10.0).

leo: Can you paste `ethtool -S` and recent `dmesg` for one affected host? Also check IRQ/softirq backpressure and LRO/GRO settings — batching can amplify coalescing effects.

anika: Paste from gpu-6a-13 (trimmed):
```
ethtool -S eth0 | grep -E 'tx|rx|drop'
tx_packets: 12498123
tx_errors: 42
tx_dropped: 1189
rx_packets: 12345011
rx_errors: 0
rx_missed: 3
```
And dmesg excerpts: 
```
[ 1432.234567] mlx5_core: QP 0x1a4 reset, reason 0x4
[ 1432.235001] mlx5_core 0000:86:00.0 eth0: mlx5_core: link state changed to DOWN
[ 1435.100123] eth0: NIC Link is Up 10000 Mbps
```

taryn: We rolled a kernel/drivers push to a subset of racks yesterday — .12 nodes got kernel 5.15.80 + new mlx driver, .13 still on 5.15.78. Could be subtly different offload behavior.

ops-bot: :warning: Alert: NOC latency anomaly detected for cluster gpu-pool-6. Rule triggered: inter-node-latency > 50ms (5m window). Incident ID: NOC-1793.

samir: Quick repro step: try disabling GRO/LRO/GSO on a witness node to see if coalescing is causing bursts that affect the NIC TX queue. Command: `sudo ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off` — run during a small controlled ramp. Also capture with `tcpdump -w /tmp/dump.pcap -s 0 host <peer>` on the two nodes.

anika: FYI I disabled GRO on gpu-6a-13 and kicked a small 10% batch; p95 dropped to ~12ms for that run. Running a few more iterations and capturing pkts now. I'll attach pcap once done.

leo: Good signal. If disabling LRO/GRO stabilizes latency, we can push a targeted NIC offload config for gpu-pool-6 or add a platform-level toggle. Longer-term: check firmware revisions and consider aligning driver/kernel across racks, or increase TOR output-queue sizes if hardware supports it.

taryn: I'll coordinate with hardware team to check TOR queue settings and firmware. For immediate mitigation I can move half of the batch traffic to gpu-pool-4 for the next 30m to keep customer SLAs while we validate.

anika: :thumbsup: running pktdump + ethtool -S on both sides now, will update with pcap link and exact numbers in ~10m.
